subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should `claws export` fail unless the installed Claw is complete and exactly corroborated, or should the current command export ledger-managed snapshots by default?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically implementable, but they create different reproducibility, lineage, user-expectation, and future compatibility contracts across the stacked Claws work; repository evidence does not establish which contract maintainers intend.

options.title: Exact state by default
options.body: Require complete corroborated state for normal export and add an explicit snapshot mode that emits structured drift and lineage metadata.

options.title: Approve snapshot default
options.body: Keep the current derivative snapshot behavior, but explicitly approve and document that exports represent selected current state rather than a reproducible exact installation.

options.title: Pause for RFC resolution
options.body: Hold this stack slice until the Claws RFC establishes export, lineage, and drift semantics shared by the downstream lifecycle work.

recommendation.title: Exact state by default
recommendation.body: Require complete corroborated state for normal export and add an explicit snapshot mode that emits structured drift and lineage metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: They articulated the unresolved product contract and the concrete acceptance criteria most directly connected to the decision.
